anomalies.observed: R1 is specified with value "5.1" (5.1 ohms) in the netlist and SPICE deck, while the identical CC2 pull-down R7 is "5.1k" and both share the same LCSC part C27834.
anomalies.expected: R1 should be 5.1 kΩ, matching R7 and the USB-C sink specification for CC pull-down resistors.

evidence.quote: USB-C CC1/CC2 pins go through R1/R7 (5.1 kΩ each) to GND

anomalies.impact: The USB-C CC1 line will present a 5.1 Ω pull-down instead of 5.1 kΩ. This violates the USB-C sink specification and may cause the USB-C source to misdetect the device, refuse to provide VBUS, or limit current, preventing the board from being powered over USB-C.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a wrong value for R1 (5.1 instead of 5.1 kΩ), which would break USB-C CC1 detection. All other reviewed aspects match the specification.
